title: Singapore Do Not Call Registry: How to Sign Up

beats.narration: I'm Alice, and today we're looking behind the curtain at Singapore's Do Not Call Registry.
It's free, and the government runs it.
There are three registers: no voice calls, no text messages, and no faxes. You can join any of them, or all three.
beats.on_screen: No Voice Call. No Text Message. No Fax.

beats.narration: Register your Singapore number online, by SMS, or by phone.
After you register, it can take up to twenty-one days to take full effect.
beats.on_screen: Up to 21 days to take full effect

beats.narration: It won't cover companies you already deal with, or public agencies, charities and surveys. For those, ask the sender to stop.
Want to see where else your details are listed? Check your exposure.
